To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

“The levels of participation in community life are low in a metropolitan area in Australia, with participation being significantly influenced by individual socio-economic status, health and demographic characteristics.”

the levels of participation are highest in informal social activities and lowest in civic activities of a collectivist nature, and that low levels of involvement in these activities are more common among people of low socioeconomic status and poor health.

1) participation is low in a range of social and community activities in an Australian metropolitan community; 2) levels of participation are significantly associated with individual demographic and socioeconomic characteristics, and health status; and 3) there is a need to develop a comprehensive strategy to increase levels of participation in community activities.

participation is important to community life and that participation is related to health.
